INSTALL_DIR:
|$HOME/farm-surveillance-v2|g" com.farm.surveillance.v2.plist > ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.farm.surveillance.v2.plist plutil -lint ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.farm.surveillance.v2.plist launchctl load ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.farm.surveillance.v2.plist (launchd does not expand ~ or env vars in plists — sed is required) --!>
Label com.farm.surveillance.v2 ProgramArguments
/.venv/bin/python3.11 -m listener.daemon
RunAtLoad
SoftResourceLimits 256 StandardErrorPath /logs/daemon.log StandardOutPath /logs/daemon.log WorkingDirectory
